issues.reason: "keep records sealed" maintains a state rather than bringing it about, so it is not the resultative *Resultatives & secondary predicates* describes, and that section's explicit fallback — "when it is genuinely unclear whether a state is caused or merely concurrent, omit Result" — makes (Result sk_keep_1 sk_sealed_1) an over-asserted causal link.

*Categorical statements* bans exactly this shape: "a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol … a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule", and sealedness is a property of each record, not of the collection as an object.

The reviewer's own q2 gap concedes the range idiom "as little as X or as much as Y" is covered by neither Disjunction nor the Measure bounds, and the emitted bounds are true and well-typed in the right directions (5 = floor, 30 = ceiling), whereas the proposed (Or …) over the two extremes would assert the term is exactly 5 or exactly 30 and exclude every value between — this is graceful improvisation in gap territory, not a defect.

The distribution half stands — *Coordination & plurals* and *Quantifiers, generics & scope* hand a distributive predicate over a plural to the members via a rule, and "keep" is distributive — but the "for its own term" half does not: per-member terms cannot be encoded while the range idiom itself has no representation.

The text supplies no kind for "others" (the source could be agencies, states or people), so (GroupOf sk_others_1 person) asserts more than the text states; the instruction set's fallback for an unsupplied kind is the neutral class, which must still be emitted ("even when thing is all that can be said").

gaps_confirmed: The range idiom "as little as X or as much as Y" — a spread across the members of a plural subject rather than a bound on one eventuality — is covered by neither the Measure bounds nor Disjunction.
The indefinite plural "others": the no-antecedent pronoun rule enumerates only he/she/they/it, leaving the group's member kind undetermined.
"keep X ADJ" (a state-maintaining secondary predicate) sits between the resultative and the depictive without being named by either.
new_gaps: A distributed per-member event cannot carry a per-member share of a range that is itself unrepresentable, so the durations stay on the group event only.
repair_summary: Dropped (Result sk_keep_1 sk_sealed_1), keeping the state as the licensed depictive (reified Experiencer state, no Result link); replaced the banned group-symbol predication (Member sk_records_1 sealed) with the distributive rule (Implication (PartOf $x sk_records_1) (Member $x sealed)) at 1.0 0.9; added the per-member keep rule over (PartOf $x sk_others_1) beside the retained group event, reusing sk_records_1 so the sealed distribution reaches the same records; changed (GroupOf sk_others_1 person) to the neutral (GroupOf sk_others_1 thing) since the text supplies no kind.
notes: The Theme role for keep, the surface participle sealed, the unmarked habitual present and the elliptical unit recovery on "30" are all correct and untouched.
